measurement_method: Decay times per mode band; bandwidth follows from B = 1/(pi*tau) and is frequency-independent, but the modal frequencies are given only as bands and are left null
note: REFERENCE ONLY. Worked check from the paper: f = 500 Hz with tau = 1 s gives Q ~ 1570.

rows.provenance: B = 1/(pi*tau) at the SLOW end of the stated decay (1.0 s): Q = pi*f*tau
B = 1/(pi*tau) at the FAST end (3.0 s)
